description: Return a bounded US weather forecast for latitude/longitude through the public National Weather Service API. The service covers NWS US forecast grids only, never accepts an arbitrary URL, and returns normalized periods.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees; NWS coverage is limited to the United States.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees; NWS coverage is limited to the United States.

periods.description: Number of forecast periods to return.

name: get_weather_forecast_nws
